scope: Length excludes exhaust; width excludes mirrors; height excludes aerial. Wheel tracks use tyre centrelines.

silhouetteReview.method: Visual comparison of front, side and top orthographic renders with the supplied drawing; no registered pixel overlay.
corrections: Body length and width; axle placement and track widths
Circular arch openings and wheel-well liners
Shorter rear-quarter windows and wider C pillars
Recessed headlamps and cleared front lamp openings
silhouetteReview.limits: Local panel curvature, lamp construction and trim remain game-model approximations; dimensional agreement does not certify historical accuracy.
